blocking_findings.title: frustum membership used as visibility
blocking_findings.support: core/colmap_io.py:205 defines in_frustum as (px in [0,W)) & (py in [0,H)) & (cam_z > 0) — image-bounds test only. No projected Gaussian ellipse, no depth competition, no opacity, no front-to-back alpha compositing, no accumulated transmittance, no per-Gaussian pixel contribution is computed anywhere.
blocking_findings.consequence: The reported '100% visible / mean visibility 0.97' is a property of frustum membership, not of physical visibility. c_vis saturation at 1.000 cannot be attributed to the real signal.

blocking_findings.title: no occlusion/transmittance calculation anywhere
blocking_findings.line_ref: whole function; depth[v, idx] stored (line 280) but never used to resolve occlusion
blocking_findings.consequence: Occluded Gaussians are treated identically to free-space Gaussians; the docstring itself defers this ('ellipse-visibility optional later', line 245).

blocking_findings.title: RGB sampled for occluded points
blocking_findings.line_ref: core/real_observation.py:282-287 (acc_color[idx] += cols for every in-frustum point, including fully occluded back-leaf points)
blocking_findings.consequence: A hidden back-leaf Gaussian inherits the foreground leaf's RGB at its projected pixel. Since overlapping leaves are geometrically adjacent, a cross-leaf edge's endpoints project to nearly the same pixels and thus share foreground RGB, biasing c_app toward 1.

blocking_findings.title: transformed xyz paired with stale ViewSignature
blocking_findings.line_ref: scripts/run_task5_phase0_gate.py (loads projection_cache/<plant>/real_viewsig_dense.npz untransformed while applying H1/V1 leaf transforms to xyz before knn_edges)
blocking_findings.consequence: kNN edges are built on transformed geometry but visible/uv/depth/appearance come from the original geometry — an internally inconsistent pairing.

blocking_findings.title: real-image/counterfactual-geometry mismatch (benchmark invalidity)
blocking_findings.line_ref: Task 2 H/V transforms move leaves to geometries that were never present in any captured RGB frame; re-projecting transformed coordinates into the original images still samples pixels of the ORIGINAL physical scene
blocking_findings.consequence: Even with corrected visibility code, the original images are not observations of the transformed benchmark cases. Any Phase-0 result on H1/V1 conflates cue failure with observation/geometry mismatch. Natural overlap cases must be used instead.

blocking_findings.title: pixel/NDC unit mismatch in c_occ
blocking_findings.line_ref: core/real_observation.py:279 stores uv = pr['pixel'] (pixels); core/geodesic_backends.py:238 documents uv as NDC and core/geodesic_backends.py:272 uses duv < 0.15 (an NDC-scale threshold)
blocking_findings.consequence: With pixel-coordinate uv (image ~2119x3777), close = duv < 0.15 almost never fires, so c_occ degenerates toward 1 - occ_rate over rel=both_vis only; the occlusion-consistency term is not computing what its documentation claims.

blocking_findings.title: hard-coded final report with fixed statistics and pre-written conclusion
blocking_findings.line_ref: hard-coded absolute REPO path, literal component statistics dict, and pre-written conclusion strings inside scripts/write_task5_final_report.py
blocking_findings.consequence: The final report is not derived from measured artifacts; it embeds its conclusions at write time.

blocking_findings.title: absence of Task 5 tests
blocking_findings.line_ref: no tests/test_real_observation*.py exists under version control covering visibility semantics, cache invalidation, or coordinate units
blocking_findings.consequence: None of F1-F6 could be caught by program-correctness tests before being reported as science.

non_blocking_observations: potpourri3d heat solver hangs on >~100K-point clouds (DouBanLv3/CaoMei1/XianKeLai2/WanNianQing1) — a practical constraint on substrate choice, not a validity issue for the Phase-0 gate computation itself.
Only DouBanLv1 of 16 dense plants yielded >=2 clean leaf pairs >=2000 pts; held-out was a second pair on the same plant. Phase 4 re-examines benchmark scope.
interpretation_rule: margin=0 from the old pipeline is NOT reinterpreted here as a scientific method failure. Its measurement conditions violated F1-F6, so it carries no evidential weight either way until recomputed under Task5R controls.
next_action: Phase 1 refactor (portability+provenance), then corrected visibility (Phase 2), then program-correctness tests (Phase 3). No scientific within-vs-cross claim may be made before Phases 1-3 pass and an observation-matched benchmark exists (Phase 4).
